name: Universidade NOVA de Lisboa
summary: Public university in Lisbon; beyond Nova SBE, four bachelor's in English: three data degrees at NOVA IMS and Global Public Health.

ib.text: EU citizens apply through the national contest: IB final grade 50%, IB exams replacing entrance exams 50%. NOVA IMS degrees need Maths AA (SL/HL) or AI HL.

programmes.name: Data Science
programmes.about: Statistics, machine learning and AI for turning large volumes of data into knowledge, taught in English at NOVA IMS on the Campolide campus; the last semester is electives (180 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL for Mathematics A, alone or with one of six second exams (2027 exam sets).

needs.note: Mathematics A is in every 2027/28 exam set; IB homologue per CNAES table 2026

programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% entrance exams; at least 100 of 200 overall.

programmes.name: Information Management
programmes.about: Data-driven management: collecting, organising and analysing information with statistical and computing tools to support business decisions, taught in English (180 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL for Mathematics A, alone or with one of six second exams (2027 exam sets).

needs.note: Mathematics A is in every 2027/28 exam set; IB homologue per CNAES table 2026

programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% entrance exams; at least 100 of 200 overall.

programmes.name: Information Systems
programmes.about: Designing and building the digital systems organisations run on: programming, databases, networks, AI and app development, linked to business goals. Taught in English (180 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL for Mathematics A, alone or with one of six second exams (2027 exam sets).

needs.note: Mathematics A is in every 2027/28 exam set; IB homologue per CNAES table 2026

programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% entrance exams; at least 100 of 200 overall.

programmes.name: Global Public Health
programmes.about: Public and global health: policy, programmes, epidemiology, biostatistics and health economics, for work in health bodies in Portugal and international organisations. Taught in English (180 ECTS).
programmes.ib: No single subject required: Maths AA or AI (SL or HL) alone meets the exam rule; other sets use Biology, Portuguese or Economics (2026 criteria).
programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% entrance exams; at least 100 of 200 overall and 95 per exam. 2026 criteria.

notes: Nova SBE, NOVA's business school, has its own page here with three more English bachelor's.
NOVA FCT's Computer Science and Engineering is billed as taught in Portuguese and English, but its catalogue lists every course unit in Portuguese, so it is not listed.
The Bachelor in Portuguese and Business is for non-native speakers with two years of university Portuguese, so it is not listed.
